summary: Skip unchanged reconciliation preparation and retain faults until work is evaluated

schema.detail: No graph or database schema change.

rules.detail: Admission, canonical ordering and checkpoint rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: An entirely unevaluated member and wake no longer publish member-recovered for a retained fault. Actual evaluated member or wake results still publish through the fresh captured-declaration authority fence. Profile spans add sql_count and reconciliation trigger classes.

downtime.detail: None beyond the normal daemon binary replacement.

recovery.detail: Unchanged local members skip workspace preparation until dependencies change, a deadline is due, runtime availability changes or the 60-second safety pass runs. Known render failures remain eligible. Actual member failures survive clean wake skips; actual success recovers only with current authority. Each effect guard reuses receipt rows within its own coherent read snapshot and preserves rejection and storage-error behavior.
